goals.summary: Handle missing payload and non-UTF-8 binary frames in WebSocketEndpoint.decode() when configured for JSON encoding.

facets.summary: When encoding is set to 'json', decode() expects either a text frame with JSON or a binary frame containing UTF-8 JSON bytes.
Empty receive events or non-UTF-8 binary data caused unhandled AttributeError, KeyError, or UnicodeDecodeError, bypassing WS_1003 closures and causing server tracebacks with WS_1011_INTERNAL_ERROR.
Ensures bytes are checked prior to decoding and catches UnicodeDecodeError to close the connection with WS_1003_UNSUPPORTED_DATA and raise RuntimeError('Malformed JSON data received.').

goals.summary: Implement performance optimizations across core requests components

facets.summary: Aiming to lower CPU and memory overhead on large responses, speed up dictionary and ASCII lookups, prevent non-monotonic timing bugs, and eliminate duplicate proxy checks.
Limits character encoding auto-detection in Response.apparent_encoding to the first 32 KB of content rather than passing the entire body.
Replaces exception-based encoding checks in unicode_is_ascii with Python's native .isascii() string method.
Uses a set comprehension instead of a list comprehension for cookiejar names in cookiejar_from_dict for constant-time lookups.
Calls getproxies() directly in resolve_proxies after an initial should_bypass_proxies check to avoid redundant bypass evaluation in get_environ_proxies.
Sets preferred_clock to time.perf_counter universally across platforms instead of using time.time() on non-Windows systems.
Author reports running pytest successfully across component tests (cookies, proxy resolution, apparent encoding, ASCII checks) and the full test suite.
